stat_descriptions.note: The canonical in-game stat description text. Pairs stat_id -> player-facing template. Replaces the hand-authored interpretation in src/knowledge/poe2_mechanics.py as the authoritative source for explain_mechanic going forward. v1 ships English-only templates across 18 root-level .csd files; per-skill descriptions under specific_skill_stat_descriptions/ now shipped separately - see per_skill_stat_descriptions entry. Headline category counts: stat_descriptions.csd 10,716 / skill_stat_descriptions.csd 1,899 / atlas 1,354 / gem 1,334 / passive_skill 208 / others <200 each.

per_skill_stat_descriptions.note: Per-skill stat descriptions deferred from PR #98's v1 scope. 296 .csd files across the specific_skill_stat_descriptions/ subdirectory (including nested skill subdirs like ancestral_cry/, ball_lightning/). Bundle keyed by relative source path so consumers only need a single file load. English-only templates. Used by explain_mechanic when a stat_id resolves to a skill-specific description rather than a global one.

data_policy: All structured data here is extracted exclusively from the maintainer's licensed PoE2 install (.datc64) and from the open-source PathOfBuilding-PoE2 community repo (for skill_gems). No third-party wiki / scraped data is bundled. See data/game/README.md for the full policy.
